basic_info.description: This spacious corner unit is filled with light and is situated on one of the coveted blocks atop Russian Hill. The well maintained 1910 Edwardian building retains its original architectural detail and elegance, featuring tall coved ceilings, wainscoting and hardwood floors throughout. The formal dining room features built-in cabinets and box beam ceilings. Charming sliding parlor pocket doors open to a spacious living room, that could be converted into a 2nd bedroom. The updated kitchen features stainless-steel appliances, quartz counter tops and subway tile backsplash. The updated bathroom has heated natural stone floors and glass shower enclosure. This wonderful home is rounded off with an in-unit laundry room. Seismic upgrades have been completed. The walkability to nearby cafes, shopping and restaurants is wonderful!
